records.name: EasyWrite
records.tagline: Desktop write and note-taking app with quick capture, search
records.description: Writing should feel simple, focused, and enjoyable, but most tools are either too bloated or too distracting. We built EasyWrite for people who just want to sit down and turn. Desktop writing and note-taking app with quick capture, search, markdown export, and tray shortcuts.

records.name: PagePilot
records.tagline: AIpowered website monitoring detects breaks and changes 24/7
records.description: PagePilot monitors your websites around the clock using a headless browser and GPT-4o AI to catch the changes and breakages that matter — before your users do. Built for operators, not engineers.

records.name: Stakyo
records.tagline: Venture studio building and acquiring SaaS products
records.description: Stakyo is a Delaware-registered digital holding company and venture studio building, acquiring, and operating SaaS products across B2B, B2C, and B2B2C markets. The current ecosystem includes SaaSale, PolyScout, and VCDir. Instead of launching one standalone app, Stakyo builds a portfolio of software products supported by shared engineering, security, product design, growth, and operational standards.

records.name: Agent Studio
records.tagline: Your local hub for agent-powered development
records.description: ✨ Agent Studio allows you to run autonomous coding agents without turning your workflow into a black box. Customize agents for each task, curate project knowledge in a built-in context library, switch smoothly between workspaces, and follow the entire pipeline as agents plan, execute, ask questions, generate artifacts, request approval, and prepare final work for review. It brings context, agents, approvals, and project history into one local workspace hub for teams.

records.name: reMarkable Tempalte
records.tagline: Navigate your notes with icons!
records.description: I’m a designer, and both in the storyboarding and planning process, the reMarkable can be an amazing tool for mobile-ready visual drawing and note-taking. Since receiving my reMarkable, I was impressed — but I often lost track of where everything was when I needed it within the pages.

records.name: MaskEngine
records.tagline: Your faceless YouTube Shorts channel. On autopilot.
records.description: Plan, create, and auto-post faceless YouTube Shorts with AI. No camera. No editor. Just growth, every day, on autopilot.MaskEngine is an AI engine that researches niches, writes scripts, generates voices and visuals, syncs captions, and auto-posts faceless YouTube Shorts straight to your channel. No camera. No editor. Just a queue of videos showing up every day.

records.name: QuoteSnap
records.tagline: Free quote calculator widget for home service pros
records.description: Free embeddable quote calculator for pressure washers, lawn care, roofing, HVAC, plumbing and more. Customers get an instant price, you get a real lead — 24/7.

records.name: Prezova
records.tagline: Your agency, elevated.
records.description: Most agencies manage clients over WhatsApp, scattered Drive folders, and endless follow-ups. Content approvals get lost. Clients feel out of the loop. Work goes unrecognised. Prezova gives every client a professional portal - content calendar, post approvals, brand strategy, and tasks. One secure link, no login needed. For agencies: AI content generation, team management, credentials vault, invoicing, and more. Try the live demo on our homepage. No signup needed.

records.name: Syncaut
records.tagline: The automation platform built for e-commerce agencies
records.description: Most automation tools weren't built for agencies. You get one flat account, no client separation, and you're rebuilding the same workflows from scratch every time a new client comes in. Syncaut fixes that. Every client gets their own workspace. Build a workflow once, save it as a template, deploy it to every client in seconds. Flat pricing — unlimited workspaces, unlimited workflows. No per-task fees, no AI markup. Bring your own API keys.

records.name: Blip AI
records.tagline: Бесплатный доступ к топовым ИИ-моделям без лагов
records.description: Blip Ai — это сверхбыстрый и минималистичный веб-интерфейс, предоставляющий бесплатный доступ к множеству передовых ИИ-моделей в одном месте. Забудь про переключение между десятками сайтов и тяжелыми официальными клиентами. Проект работает прямо в браузере, мгновенно генерирует ответы, поддерживает удобную смену тем и полностью адаптирован под мобильные устройства. Весь потенциал современных нейросетей в едином, легком и чистом UI без лишнего визуального шума.

records.name: Laptop AI
records.tagline: Local-first AI assistant with memory for your own files
records.description: Laptop AI lets you chat with your own files directly from the terminal using local AI models and vector memory. Unlike cloud AI tools, your data stays on your laptop. Built for developers, researchers, students, and privacy-focused users who want fast retrieval and persistent memory without sending files to external servers

records.name: Sched Fit
records.tagline: AI-powered gym workout planner and tracker
records.description: Frankly, when I started training, I thought there was already at least one similar app, but I was quick to develop it. The category is flooded with complex apps, which are basically not very flexible and usable. My app has the advantage of being extremely practical, but at the same time powerful, halfway between the classic workout plan in PDF and an app that is so complex that it is preferable to the PDF.

records.name: Realistic AI Image Generator
records.tagline: Create photorealistic images for ads ecommerce and marketing
records.description: Unlike art-focused AI tools, we specialize in commercial photorealism with studio-quality lighting, natural textures, and zero "AI artifacts". Built for ecommerce product shots, marketing ads, and professional portraits that look 100% real.

records.name: Sunder
records.tagline: Install tools, or build your own with AI Agent Builder
records.description: Sunder is not a window manager, plugin directory, or another AI chatbot. It is an open-source desktop app where tools are installed as packages. Packages can become dashboards, file utilities, command buttons, automations, API panels, hardware controls, AI agents, or local workflows. With Agent Builder, you can create a new native Sunder package by chatting with an AI agent instead of setting up a full desktop dev environment.

records.name: AI Video Analytics Software Services
records.tagline: Real-Time AI for Smarter Security
records.description: Leading AI video analytics software for smart surveillance, real-time monitoring, and business intelligence. It transforms video feeds into actionable data. Detects people, vehicles, crowd behavior, license plates, and safety violations instantly. Sends real-time alerts for faster decisions. Deploys on edge, cloud, or hybrid. Achieves 95%+ accuracy. Powers retail, manufacturing, smart cities, and healthcare. Proven results: 35% better traffic flow and 40% fewer incidents.

records.name: AI Aware
records.tagline: Detection of AI-generated text, deepfakes, audio and images
records.description: Existing AI content detection products tend to detect one form of content - AI Aware detects all four (text, images, video and audio). This will be important as AI develops and threats become increasingly multi-modal. Existing detectors also tend to be built around one detection model leaning heavily on machine learning which means they make mistakes when confronted with content not trained on. Ours combines models, along with identifying patterns across generators, for more accurate detection.

records.name: diVote AI
records.tagline: AI political intelligence and narrative monitoring
records.description: diVote combines conversational monitoring, behavioral analysis, and adaptive polling into AI-generated strategic intelligence reports. The platform analyzes real online discussions, detects organic versus coordinated behavior, tracks emotional narratives, and helps political campaigns, media organizations, and research teams understand public sentiment in real time.

records.name: Transcribe Video AI
records.tagline: 100% video to text converter online, no sign up.

No CRM clutter. No AI fluff. No overpriced plans. Built for indie makers, startups, small businesses, and teams that just want chat to work. Launching with simple, transparent pricing: $9 per seat.

records.name: Megsy

It's now an integral part of our development process because of how much it cuts down the Apple review back-and-forth. We're confident it can do the same for you. Run a free App Check now and get your risk report. It’s a simple, three-minute process.

SongHit lets you experiment with both, side by side, for the same prompt — perfect for finding the right sound for vocals, instrumentals, or anything in between.

records.description: Ditch boring checklists! TaviNote turns travel prep into a serene game. Place a widget on your home screen to watch your trees bloom and see your pets resting by their roots at a glance. You can also invite friends to co-plan details together in real-time. Make travel prep a heartwarming journey!

records.description: Seize the Day is a clean, fast daily planner built for people who want to get things done — not spend hours setting up their system. ✦ Drag tasks onto your calendar (works on iPad too) ✦ Category colors to organize at a glance ✦ D-Day countdowns for important dates ✦ Works as a PWA — no app store needed ✦ Available in 6 languages Built for students, creators, and anyone who wants to own their day.

records.name: HPR - Human Pattern Recorder
records.tagline: A compiled activity tracker that actually works on wayland.
records.description: HPR watches your active window all day and tells you exactly where your time went. No background server, no web UI, no accounts, no telemetry. Just a compiled C++23 binary that writes to a local SQLite file. Works natively on Windows, Linux (Hyprland, GNOME, KDE, Cinnamon) with zero setup friction on Windows and minimal one-time setup on Linux. If you've ever looked at ActivityWatch and thought 'this is way too much for what I need' - HPR is what you were looking for.

records.name: Congress Copy Calculator
records.tagline: See if copying Congress beats the S&P 500
records.description: Members of Congress trade stocks, and the law makes every trade public. This free tool lets you test whether copying them actually beats the market: pick a member, pick a dollar amount, and see what copying all their disclosed trades would be worth today, next to the same money in the S&P 500. Just pick and compare.

records.name: HTML Formatter
records.tagline: Free browser-based HTML beautifier, formatter & validator
records.description: HTML Formatter is a free, browser-based tool that lets developers instantly clean, format, and validate HTML code — no login, no file uploads to a server, no fluff. records.name: PostDrop
records.tagline: The easiest headless form backend API for frontend devs.
records.description: Stop writing backend code just to handle simple contact forms! 🚀 PostDrop is a zero-dependency, headless form backend built explicitly for frontend developers. Connect any HTML, React, or Tailwind form to our API endpoint instantly. We handle the heavy lifting: routing data to your custom dashboard, sending clean notification emails via Resend without hosting blocks, and filtering out spam. Ship your static sites faster, monetize with ease, and connect effortlessly with your customers.

records.name: Powabase
records.tagline: Build AI apps with Postgres, RAG, and agents
records.description: Powabase is a backend-as-a-service for AI-native applications, combining Postgres, RAG, agents, memory, workflows, and automation primitives in one platform. It helps agencies and in-house IT teams build new AI apps or add AI automation to existing products without stitching together fragmented infrastructure. Designed to work seamlessly with modern coding agents, Powabase helps teams ship faster while building more robust, token-efficient systems.

records.name: Noesia
records.tagline: An AI that learns how you think
records.description: Noesia is an AI that learns how a real person thinks. Through questions and interaction, it builds a persona model based on values, decision patterns, and thinking tendencies. Unlike character AI, the goal is not roleplay but reproducing a person’s actual way of judging, reacting, and expressing themselves. The short-term value is self-understanding; the long-term direction is reusable persona intelligence through an API.

records.name: Buzbit — Find Your People Through Books
records.tagline: Find your people through the books you love
records.description: Buzbit is a book community app where shared reading taste leads to real friendships. Write reviews, discuss books like on Reddit, and connect with people who read what you read — then take it further with voice and video calls. Most reading apps track your books. Buzbit helps you find your people. We're live on both App Store and Google Play. Would love feedback from real readers — especially what's missing or what you'd want to see.

records.name: Bookkeeping-OCR
records.tagline: Desktop bookkeeping with OCR. No subscription. No cloud.
records.description: Bookkeeping-OCR is a standalone desktop app for solo business owners who want clean books without the complexity of enterprise software — or the monthly fee. Scan receipts with OCR, record revenue, track expenses by category, and run reports — all on your own machine. Your data never leaves your computer. One-time purchase. Runs on Mac and Windows. Built by a solo developer using AI as a development partner from architecture through shipping. The build journey is documented on LinkedIn.

records.name: Skarta
records.tagline: Build agents in Python. Ship them on a Rust runtime.
records.description: Skarta is a production-grade Rust runtime for multi-agent systems. Write agents in Python, ship them on a Rust binary that owns scheduling, validation, sessions, budgets, telemetry, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop approvals. One install. Apache 2.0.

records.name: ASO Boost
records.tagline: We help iOS Devs Find Keywords and Grow Installs Organically
records.description: Supercharge your iOS app with ASO Boost. ASO Boost is an all-in-one iOS App Store Optimization tool for Keyword Research, Rank Tracking, Competitor Analysis, ASO audit and Metadata Editor Tool. All the reliable data on keywords are directly sourced from Apple Search Ads and iTunes. Get Started with our free plan where you can explore all the features with it.

records.name: CircadiaOS
records.tagline: Sleep optimization, minus the $3,000 mattress pod
records.description: CircadiaOS is software-only sleep optimization. No mattress pod, no proprietary sensor, no new hardware. It connects the wearable and smart thermostat you already own, builds a personalized overnight temperature schedule from your biometrics, and runs your thermostat through it automatically every night. Most premium sleep tech in this category has been hardware-first: thousand-dollar mattress pods, dedicated sensors, custom firmware. We took the opposite bet.

records.name: Neurovascular Dynamic Lab
records.tagline: Free neuroscience education — from Africa, for the world 🧠
records.description: Free neuroscience education for students across Africa and beyond. Learn brain anatomy, neurons, neurovascular diseases, quizzes, flashcards and more.

records.name: Angle
records.tagline: Create strategy and marketing assets visually with AI
records.description: A new collaborative visual AI workspace for planning strategy and creating marketing assets. It helps you work visually with your product, audience, positioning, and goals, then turns that context into visuals, videos, and campaign material. Create, review, repurpose, and ship from one connected workspace without losing context between tools.

records.name: DepsGuard
records.tagline: Configure once, prevent the next compromised package install
records.description: Prevent the next npm supply chain compromise like the GitHub, axios, @tanstack attacks from impacting you. One command to scan and fix npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, and uv configs using security best practices. Free and open source (MIT), 100% Rust, zero dependencies, brought to you by the AppSec experts at Arnica.

records.name: Threej Games
records.tagline: Play opensource online games for free
records.description: Play free browser games on Threej Games. Discover open-source arcade, puzzle, racing, strategy, and board games that launch instantly in your browser.

records.name: Jinkō-Mage RE Studio
records.tagline: AI virtual staging, MLS-compliant 4-hour turnaround
records.description: AI virtual staging for real estate agents and developers. Upload an empty room photo → get a professionally staged, MLS-compliant image in under 4 hours. Architecture-locked, so no phantom windows or doorways. Style-consistent across entire developments. Disclosure overlays included for MLS upload. $25–$50 per room. Used by luxury developers in Dubai and the US.

records.name: CleanSubmit
records.tagline: Humanize your ai writing
records.description: Submit your academic and professional documents for expert human review. Receive comprehensive feedback and similarity reports with guaranteed turnaround times.

records.name: Mortgage50 – Affordability Calculator
records.tagline: Turn mortgage website traffic into qualified leads
records.description: Mortgage50 is a modern U.S. home affordability calculator for mortgage lenders and brokers. Many mortgage websites still use outdated calculators that don't engage visitors or help convert traffic into leads. Mortgage50 solves this with a fast, lightweight widget that can be embedded into any website. It can be branded to match your site and configured with a custom call-to-action to capture leads. Our goal is simple: increase engagement, build trust, and generate more qualified leads.

records.name: Passport Index Immigrant Invest
records.tagline: Passport Index: Worlds Strongest Passport Rankings
records.description: Passport Index by Immigrant Invest is an interactive tool to analyze 193 passports across 4 crucial pillars: mobility, asset protection, quality of life, and a secure "Plan B". Unlike standard visa trackers, it also evaluates taxes, safety, healthcare, and business climates. Perfect for investors, expats, and entrepreneurs looking for the ultimate relocation or investment destination in just a few clicks. We’d love to hear your feedback!
